description: In recent discussions, several countries have proposed the introduction of a marriage cooling-off period, where couples who are about to marry would have a mandatory waiting period to reflect on their decision before proceeding. Proponents argue that this could reduce impulsive decisions and allow individuals more time to ensure they are making the right choice, while critics believe it may infringe on personal freedom and delay the joy of marriage. The proposal has sparked debates across various social and political groups.
